name: Captain Ravna
title: The Red Company
examine: The mask hangs off her belt like a clerk's seal, which is what it is. She runs the Company the way other people run shipping concerns, and the concern is doing well.
lines: Five doors, one hall, no landlord. The Crown taxes what it can see. Note what it can see down here.
The Company is a business. The mask is the uniform. The knife is the contract law.
We do not work the nursery, we do not burn what pays twice, and we do not forget. Those are all three of the rules.
